description: A script for running web page load experiments using either wget or a custom quic_client, including functions for timestamp generation, page URL parsing, and experiment execution.

classes.name: PageloadExperiment
classes.description: Class to manage and run web page load experiments using wget or quic_client.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in microseconds or converts a given datetime to timestamp.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the experiment with configuration parameters.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.ReadPages
methods.description: Reads a JSON file and returns a list of URLs for each page, including resources.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.DownloadOnePage
methods.description: Downloads a page (or resources) using wget or quic_client and returns download time and max packet number.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.RunExperiment
methods.description: Runs the experiment for a specified number of iterations, saving delay and packet data to CSV files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line options and runs the experiment.
